purpose: Static prerequisite and eligibility audit only for a zero-fit height-only KMAPP terrain-correction branch. No DEM value retrieval, model fit, prediction, or metric call.

frozen_checks.license_gate: Official licence must grant worldwide, unlimited-time reproduction, distribution, public communication, adaptation/modification/combination, free of charge, with no field-of-use restriction; commercial use is inferred only from these explicit rights and absence of a non-commercial restriction, not from a search snippet.
frozen_checks.time_gate: Official product metadata must establish static source acquisition and public availability before 2026-07-05.
frozen_checks.availability_gate: Anonymous HEAD of the exact N37/E128 GLO-30 tile must return 200 with positive content length; no range/body request is permitted in this node.
frozen_checks.model_orography_gate: Within operating days through 2023-12-31, LDAPS surface_0_h must be finite, constant within grid_id, and present for every frozen grid; coordinates must likewise be constant per grid.
frozen_checks.formula_inputs_gate: Static turbine coordinates/hub height from N12, LDAPS model orography, and an eligible 30 m DSM must together cover the inputs needed by the published height-only formula. The next extraction node must still freeze exact terrain-statistic definitions before downloading values.

verdict_rule.BLOCKED: any gate fails or is not directly supported

forbidden: GET/range/body access to the DEM tile
